_about: Design tokens for Handspan (working name). Style: native iOS 26, Liquid Glass on the control layer, frosted cards over a sky gradient (user's reference image). Brand palette set by /replica-brand on 2026-11-10: Tide (cerulean) is the one brand hue, with neutral ink and no violet anywhere. Role names stay; only values change. Glass and translucent surfaces are checked at their composited colour over the worst background they sit on (noted per token). Check with: python3 contrast.py tokens.json

light._surface: card: white 85% over sky-mid/bg, composited worst case
light._surface-sunken: stacked strip behind/under a card: white 55% over sky-mid

font.sans: SF Pro (system font, Dynamic Type). Web preview: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
font.rounded: SF Pro Rounded, for numbers in rings, stars and streaks only

type._about: Point sizes at the default Dynamic Type size (Large). In SwiftUI use the text style, never a fixed size, so it scales.

title._use: screen header pair: 'Today' in text, date in text-muted

layout._ipad: iPad: content column max 640pt centred; player uses full width

radius._about: Corners nest: inner = outer - padding. In SwiftUI prefer ConcentricRectangle / .containerConcentric on iOS 26 so cards follow the device corners.

shadow._glass: Liquid Glass draws its own depth. Never add a shadow to a .glassEffect view.

glass._about: Liquid Glass (iOS 26 .glassEffect) is for the control layer that floats over content: tab bar, toolbar, floating buttons, pause menu, sheets, the player HUD. Content (cards, lists, the staff) uses solid or frosted surfaces, never glass on glass.
glass.interactive: .glassEffect(.regular.interactive())  // buttons and chips: reacts to touch
glass.tinted: .glassEffect(.regular.tint(tint).interactive())  // one prominent action per screen at most
glass.container: GlassEffectContainer(spacing: 16) around neighbouring glass so shapes blend and morph
glass.fallback: iOS 26 is the minimum target, so no fallback is needed. Reduce Transparency is handled by the system for glass; custom frosted cards switch to solid surface.

motion.reward: Animation.bouncy(duration: 0.5, extraBounce: 0.1)  // stars, level up, streak
motion.morph: matchedGeometryEffect / glassEffectID + Animation.smooth(duration: 0.4)  // CTA becomes player HUD
motion.key-feedback: Animation.linear(duration: 0.06)  // note colour on the staff and keys: never springy, it must feel instant
motion.reduce-motion: replace movement with .opacity crossfade, Animation.easeInOut(duration: 0.2); no parallax, no scale bounce
motion.haptics: .sensoryFeedback(.success) on a passed stage, .impact(weight: .light) on a correct note in wait mode only, .error never (a wrong note is not a failure)
